visual_identity.color_palette: Deep teal-green skin with vibrant sunset-orange 'tiger stripes' along the tail and neck; pale cream underbelly.
visual_identity.texture: Smooth matte clay texture with a subtle pearlescent sheen on the snout to mimic wet skin.
visual_identity.distinguishing_marks: Large, curved black talons on the thumbs; a series of small, rounded 'clay' bumps along the ridge of its crocodile-like snout.

anatomy_constraints.head: Long, low crocodile-like skull with a slight notch near the tip of the snout; large, friendly, expressive yellow eyes.
anatomy_constraints.limbs: Robust arms with three fingers; the first finger (thumb) features a significantly larger hooked claw.
anatomy_constraints.body: Slender but muscular theropod frame; a tail with tall neural spines that give it a slightly flattened, 'paddle' appearance for swimming.

visual_logic.subject: A friendly, stylized Riparovenator with a curious expression.
visual_logic.action: Standing on a mottled red clay bank, one foot splashing into grey silty water, while watching a prehistoric dragonfly.
visual_logic.environment: Background features charred 'plant debris' logs (lignite) and sparse, Mediterranean-style conifers (Pseudofrenelopsis) under a bright Cretaceous sun.

personality: The 'Patient Fisher'—calm, observant, and highly agile in water. He has a slightly more graceful, rhythmic movement style compared to the high-energy Allosaurus.
